Privacy

Privacy and disclaimers.

What we collect through this website, why, what you can ask us to do with it, and the limits of our estimates. Last updated November 23, 2026.

Who we are

Town Talk Marketing Solutions (“Town Talk”, “we”) is an independent marketing consultancy with offices in Muskoka and Brock, Ontario. We handle personal information in line with Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA). Jared Jylha is responsible for privacy at Town Talk and can be reached at jared@towntalk.ca or (289) 338-4051.

What we collect

  • Contact form. Your name, email, and anything else you choose to give us: business name, phone number, the service you're interested in, your monthly ad spend range and your message.
  • Ad budget estimator. If you ask to see your channel mix, your name, email and business name, plus the answers you gave and the budget and channel mix the tool showed you.
  • Rebate calculator demo. Nothing. The demo on our Technology page runs in your browser and does not send the details you enter anywhere.
  • Technical information. Like most websites, our hosting and security providers receive your IP address, browser type and the pages you request so they can deliver the site and block abuse.

How we use it

We use the information you send us to reply to you, prepare for a call you've booked, and follow up about the services you asked about. We don't sell or rent personal information, and we don't add you to a mailing list unless you ask us to.

Consent

By sending us a form, you consent to us using your information for the purposes above. You can withdraw your consent at any time by emailing us, and we'll stop contacting you and delete your information unless we need to keep it by law.

Service providers we use

A few companies help us run this site. They may process information outside Canada, including in the United States, where it can be subject to local laws.

  • Web3Forms delivers form submissions to our email inbox.
  • Google reCAPTCHA protects our forms from spam. It collects information about your device and how you use the page, and may set cookies. Its use is subject to Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
  • Google Fonts supplies the fonts on this site, so your browser requests them from Google.
  • Cloudflare hosts the website and protects it from attacks.

Cookies and analytics

This site does not currently use analytics or advertising cookies. Google reCAPTCHA may set its own cookies to tell people from bots. If we add analytics or advertising tools in the future, we'll update this page first.

How long we keep it

We keep your information only as long as we need it for the purposes above, or as required by law, then delete it.

Your rights

You can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email jared@towntalk.ca and we'll respond within 30 days. If you're not satisfied with our answer, you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

Disclaimers

Rebate estimates. Rebate amounts shown by our calculators are estimates based on publicly posted program details. They aren't a guarantee of funding. Programs can change or end without notice, and the program administrator makes all final decisions. Town Talk isn't affiliated with Enbridge Gas, Save on Energy or the Government of Ontario.

Not legal advice. Our reviews of advertising contracts and agency agreements are commercial advice about costs, terms and value. They aren't legal advice. For legal interpretation of a contract, please speak with a qualified lawyer.

Estimates and results. Budget ranges, channel mixes and other figures on this site are general guidance, not a promise of specific sales, leads or return on investment.

Changes

We'll post any changes to this policy on this page and update the date at the top.
